Instructions for Setting Up a Hosted Catalog Managed by the Buyer Org
ePRO-3000: ePro Specialization
Managing Catalogs

Background JAGGAER eProcurement clients may have the ability to manage inter nal catalogs (for example, item s available from a stockroom, a campus bookstore, or other client‐operated sourc e) or manage hosted catalogs for specific suppliers. For either of these options, onc e licenses, settings, etc. are in place, you must create and configure an instance of the supplier in the client/demo org specifically for the purpos e of managing this supplier. Doing this for one internal supplier requires that the Item Master license be turned on for a site. It also requires some background tasks that can onl y be performed by a JAGGAER u ser with access to the SQSupport environment and appropriate permissions. This is typically handled by the Supplier Integrations Team. This handout is intended for internal JAGGAER users who need to set this up in their sandbo x sites for demo or other purposes. This is supplemental to the ePRO‐3000 curriculum, an d purely optional. JAGGAER partner users can perform some of these tasks, but will need assistance to do the back‐end configuration steps.

sections.title: Procedure
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 2 | 16
First, the Item Master license has to be on for the site (for your training sandbox, i t should be already).
Log in as a JAGGAER user. Again, if you only have a partner use r role, you can do some of these steps but will need help for certain ones, which are specified below.

1. Enable the Internal Store supplier class and rename it: o Go to the Suppliers > Configuration Settings > Manage Supplier Classes page and enable the Internal Store class, and rename it to Client Internal Catalog Suppliers . o Make it active. o Assign an icon to it and give it top priority for search filter s.
2. Grant the permissions necessary to the relevant roles to manage the catalog: o Give the System Admin and Catalog Admin roles the following per missions: o Administration > System Administration:
• Edit Items / Catalogs
• Syndicate Items / Prices o Administration > Catalog Administration
• Catalog Management
• Manage Content
• Approve All Supplier Price Files

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization

Once you’ve done that, your user (who has the System Admin role) should see new hosted catalog options from the Contracts flyout ‐ the same ones a supplier would see in the portal. We’ll come back to that.

3. Add the new supplier: o From the Suppliers icon, add a new "internally managed supplier" and give it a name. o Note : Do not send an email invitation to register. o Note : This cannot be a supplier who has logged into the supplier portal; it has to be an entirely client‐managed instance of the supplier. If the client already does business with the supplier and the supplier logs in to the portal, the client should upload their own catalog that way.
4. Configure the Supplier:
a. Make them Active for Shopping from the General tab.
b. In the supplier’s profile, assign it to the Client Internal Catalog Suppliers class.
c. (JAGGAER user) From the System Settings tab, click " Has Catalog "
d. From Contacts and Locations > Addresses , Use the Add an Address with Address Wizard option to set up an address and fulfillment center for the supplier.

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 4 | 16
5. Set the order distribution: o In Contacts and Location > Fulfillment Centers > Order Distributio n , enable email order delivery and make up an email address.

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 5 | 16
6. (JAGGAER user) Expose list pricing.
7. Enable list pricing: o eProcurement > Price Config/List Price o Use List Pricing: Yes

8. (JAGGAER user) Determine the display name of the site: o Find the organization’s display name by navigating to Setup > Site Profile > Configure Site Profile Miscellaneous Settings. You will need to know this for the next step.

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 6 | 16

9. (JAGGAER user) Identify the supplier portal with the display name of the clien t site: o In the supplier profile, navigate to About > General > Supplier Portal Settings > Supplier Organization and enter the client/demo org ID display name here. Start typi ng in the org name and it should show up via type‐ahead functionality.
• Warning : You must get it right because once you Save, you cannot chang e this setting!
• Note : If needed, you will be able to do this for multiple self‐mana ged catalog vendors.
• Warning : Always use your site’s org name/number and not the name of an y other site!

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 7 | 16
10. (JAGGAER user) Enable the catalog availability for the site: o eProcurement > Catalog Availability

10. Add the supplier ID and name to the item file: o From the class files, open the catalog item file called: catalog_item file ‐ USD_org‐ managed.xlsx o Put your new Supplier’s Supplier ID in cell A1 and your supplier’s name in cell B1. You can get this information from the supplier profile in About > Summary .

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 8 | 16

11. Submit the catalog for syndication: o From Contracts > Hosted Catalog Items and Price > Submit Hosted Cont ent and Price Data , validate this item file. Be sure to use the Content – Update/Add option from the Submission Type dropdown. o (Alternately, or in the future, you can also download a hosted catalog sample data file from Instructions and Templates.)

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 9 | 16
o If validation is successful , an option appears to Import All Changes. Click this and select Import and Syndicate.

12. Verify the item import: o Navigate to Contracts > Hosted Catalog Items and Price > Hos ted Catalog Ite ms . You should see the name of the se lf‐managed supplier you just c reated in the Supplier search box. (If you added another self‐managed supplier, you would be able to choose the supplier here.) o Click Search to display the items that were imported.

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 10 | 16

13. Shop for an item from the list. o See if your Supplier appears and that it has a price. For those users whose default currency is not US dollars, they will see the price in their default currency base d on the exchange rate. o Note: Items imported must be indexed by the system, and this can take a while. In some instances, it may not happen until over the fo llowing weekend when the system runs a complete re‐indexing.

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization

If this supplier’s price list w ill be in a currency other than US dollars, you will need to upload a separate client‐specific price file with the other currencies.
14. Disable list price: o eProcurement > Price Config/List Price o Use List Pricing: No

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 12 | 16

15. Change the default currency for your site from US dollars to your currency: o Go to Setup > General Site Settings > System Settings and Configurati on > International Settings in International Settings and select the currency.

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
Last updated 7/15/2020. JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 2020, JAGGAER Page 13 | 16
16. Enable this currency for all suppliers: o Setup > General Site Settings > Configure Currency Settings

17. Give users access to the cu rrency the supplier is using: o Go ahead and give that to all us ers if you would like by settin g it on the Base Role. (If only a certain group needed access to t his supplier, setting up a role for them that provided access to that currency would be one way to accomplish this.)

sections.title: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization
paragraphs: JI-ePRO-3000: JAGGAER Indirect eProcurement Specialization

18. Upload the non‐USD price list for your supplier. o The item file you uploaded in the previous exercise contained l ist pricing in USD. If you were adding an internally managed supplier from the start who provid ed pricing not in USD, then you would leave the Corporate List(USD) column (column F) blank. If you changed this column to zeros, it would make all the pr icing [importo] if you were using list pricing. o To upload the price list for yo ur supplier, in your class files , open: catalog_price file ‐ world currencies_org‐managed.xlsx Put your supplier’s Supplier ID in cell A1 and your supplier’s name in cell B1. You can get this information from the supplie r profile in your sandbox. If you would like to add or change a currency column, you may d o so.
19. (JAGGAER user) Create a relationship between the client organization and the s elf‐managed supplier: o Tools > Manage Buyers, Suppliers, and Relati onships > Create Re lationships

20. Upload the price list. o Contracts > Hosted Catalog Items and Price > Submit Hosted Cont ent and Price Data o Submission Type: Prices – Add/Update o Remember, an indexing may be re quired, so results won’t be imme diate.
